subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should agents receive both Slack channel metadata lookup and token-visible conversation enumeration, and what credential and action-gating policy should authorize each action?
rationale: This is a new agent-visible workspace metadata surface; current code and prior proposals do not establish the intended discovery breadth, credential preference, authorization behavior, or configuration contract.

options.title: Approve both with explicit limits
options.body: Implement both actions with documented conversation types, full pagination, explicit credential selection, scope limits, and a narrow action gate.

options.title: Approve channel lookup only
options.body: Expose metadata for caller-supplied channel IDs while deferring workspace-wide enumeration to reduce discovery breadth.

options.title: Keep metadata internal
options.body: Retain current internal resolution for context and authorization without adding agent-callable discovery actions.

recommendation.title: Approve both with explicit limits
recommendation.body: Implement both actions with documented conversation types, full pagination, explicit credential selection, scope limits, and a narrow action gate.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal from direct issue follow-up and repeated recent work across the Slack action runtime and plugin boundary.
